description: The agent must: (1) Read the event data from `events/hackathon_2024/raw_assets/` (schedule_data.json and copywriting.txt). (2) Generate `hackathon_poster.png` using PIL in RGBA mode, compositing a semi-transparent frosted-glass overlay (alpha < 255) over a background, and drawing a visible border rectangle — matching the Glassmorphism philosophy from SKILL.md (blur/transparency/subtle border). (3) Generate `hackathon_schedule.pdf` using fpdf2 with bold font (`set_font('Arial', 'B', ...)`) and non-default fill/text colors in cells — matching Brutalism (bold typography, clashing colors). A naive agent will produce plain text files or miss the RGBA transparency requirement and bold+color PDF requirements, failing the philosophy-specific rendering checks.
